exposure: Use of evidence-based practices (EBPs) during labor
outcome: Use of non-pharmacological pain relief methods
cohort: Brazilian women who participated in the Senses of Birth (SoB) health education intervention
finding: Doula support was significantly associated with vaginal delivery among Brazilian women participating in a health education intervention promoting normal birth and evidence-based practices.
mod_finding: Doula support was significantly associated with vaginal delivery.
